title: Native run of loader-diag-xnu-sb-md1 (decision 0036), the documented Stage A re-run after the NAT-091 delivery shortfall: nineteen of Apple's own LaunchDaemons plists plus the ps heartbeat in the small root under restore-mode launchd, on an idle host; which Apple daemons does launchd start, which are in the last ps -A list, which died and why
acceptance: One run under decision 0036 (committed before the launch), RECOVERY only, restored from the pinned stock by NAT-013 with the pyusb venv python; Android and data checked afterwards; no retry; the host load at launch recorded.

Judged by analyze_nat087.py (the chain rows) and analyze_nat089.py (rows A1-A8 over the per-label table) unchanged, with the facts they report: boot tasks in order, per-label spawns, exits with launchd's wording, domains, the last ps -A list, failure-word lines, holes and gap, PID 1 exit or panic, the ending, the delivery rate and whether the root arrived whole.
Any row other than A1 is recorded as the finding with its numbers and does not complete the task.
